voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: December eighteen seventy-two. A sailing ship was found drifting in the Atlantic with no one aboard.
She was still seaworthy. Her cargo, seventeen hundred barrels of alcohol, was almost untouched. There was plenty of food and water.
Ten people had sailed on her: the captain, his wife, their two-year-old daughter and seven crew. The ship's only boat was gone.
Her last log entry, nine days earlier, put her off the Azores, nearly four hundred nautical miles from where she was found.
No one has ever proved why they left. Not one of the ten was ever seen again.
